From 5a4391bdc6c8357242f62f22069c865b792406b3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Marc Kleine-Budde <mkl@pengutronix.de>
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 12:52:27 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] can: esd_usb: esd_usb_read_bulk_callback(): fix URB memory
 leak

Fix similar memory leak as in commit 7352e1d5932a ("can: gs_usb:
gs_usb_receive_bulk_callback(): fix URB memory leak").

In esd_usb_open(), the URBs for USB-in transfers are allocated, added to
the dev->rx_submitted anchor and submitted. In the complete callback
esd_usb_read_bulk_callback(), the URBs are processed and resubmitted. In
esd_usb_close() the URBs are freed by calling
usb_kill_anchored_urbs(&dev->rx_submitted).

However, this does not take into account that the USB framework unanchors
the URB before the complete function is called. This means that once an
in-URB has been completed, it is no longer anchored and is ultimately not
released in esd_usb_close().

Fix the memory leak by anchoring the URB in the
esd_usb_read_bulk_callback() to the dev->rx_submitted anchor.

Fixes: 96d8e90382dc ("can: Add driver for esd CAN-USB/2 device")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260116-can_usb-fix-memory-leak-v2-2-4b8cb2915571@pengutronix.de
Signed-off-by: Marc Kleine-Budde <mkl@pengutronix.de>

diff --git a/drivers/net/can/usb/esd_usb.c b/drivers/net/can/usb/esd_usb.c
index 08da507faef4..8cc924c47042 100644
--- a/drivers/net/can/usb/esd_usb.c
+++ b/drivers/net/can/usb/esd_usb.c
@@ -541,13 +541,20 @@ static void esd_usb_read_bulk_callback(struct urb *urb)
 			  urb->transfer_buffer, ESD_USB_RX_BUFFER_SIZE,
 			  esd_usb_read_bulk_callback, dev);
 
+	usb_anchor_urb(urb, &dev->rx_submitted);
+
 	err = usb_submit_urb(urb, GFP_ATOMIC);
+	if (!err)
+		return;
+
+	usb_unanchor_urb(urb);
+
 	if (err == -ENODEV) {
 		for (i = 0; i < dev->net_count; i++) {
 			if (dev->nets[i])
 				netif_device_detach(dev->nets[i]->netdev);
 		}
-	} else if (err) {
+	} else {
 		dev_err(dev->udev->dev.parent,
 			"failed resubmitting read bulk urb: %pe\n", ERR_PTR(err));
 	}
-- 
2.34.1

### Summary of Modifications

#### Changes in `drivers/net/can/usb/esd_usb.c`:
- In the `esd_usb_read_bulk_callback()` function:
  - **Added `usb_anchor_urb(urb, &dev->rx_submitted)`** before resubmitting the URB to ensure the URB remains anchored in the `dev->rx_submitted` list. This prevents a memory leak when `esd_usb_close()` calls `usb_kill_anchored_urbs()` – without re-anchoring, completed URBs would be unanchored by the USB core and not freed.
  - **Restructured error handling**: After attempting to resubmit the URB with `usb_submit_urb()`:
    - If successful (`!err`), the function returns immediately, leaving the URB anchored.
    - If submission fails, `usb_unanchor_urb(urb)` is called to remove the URB from the anchor list before error processing, preventing double-free or dangling references.
  - Changed the conditional for error reporting from `else if (err)` to `else` since the earlier `if (!err) return` ensures only failure cases reach the error handling block.

#### Relationship between Modifications:
The changes are intrinsically linked: the core fix is the re-anchoring of the URB prior to resubmission. The error handling adjustments are necessary to properly clean up the anchor if resubmission fails, ensuring the memory management logic remains consistent and leak-free. The overall effect is a correct lifecycle for URBs: they are anchored when initially submitted in `esd_usb_open()`, re-anchored on each resubmission in the callback, and properly freed during device close.
